verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Shortwave acting only as an MCP client: its own built-in AI Assistant connects outward to other MCP servers via "Add custom integration". Nothing documents a Shortwave MCP server or public API that Claude, ChatGPT, or a user's own agent could use to read, triage, draft, and send mail, and probes for an OpenAPI spec returned 404. The single Tasklet partner integration that places drafts in Shortwave is an adjacent integration, not a general documented connection covering read, triage, and send.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an external agent — Claude, ChatGPT, or my own — can read, triage, draft, and send my email end to end through a documented connection
